evidence.quote: I believe that additional policy rate increases will be necessary to bring inflation down to our target over time.
But while headline inflation has declined substantially, it remains far too high. Therefore, I believe there is more work to do to bring inflation down.
we have seen core inflation essentially plateau since the fall of 2022
Jobs have grown at a solid pace, wages have increased for many workers, and we've seen continued low unemployment.
I supported the FOMC's decision last week to hold the federal funds rate target range steady and to continue to reduce the Fed's securities holdings
